title: Complete resolved SAM–LAM–rotation cumulative reaction probability
summary: Assemble owner-calculated regularized anharmonic SAM transmissions with qualified DVR LAM and resolved rotational spectra; exact mode accounting, physical energy thresholds, explicit statistical conventions and independent canonical/convergence gates precede the E,J master-equation handoff.
gates: Native nonredundant ESALC-I fields with metric terms and explicit mode identities; one unstable reaction coordinate excluded from bound statistics
SAM transmission from resident Miller, SCT or evaluated SCTST-SCT continuation; no canonical-to-microcanonical inversion or minimum between standalone SCT and SCTST
Regularized HDCPT2/GVPT2 occupation model with declared coverage, frozen parallel WL measurement and independent replicas or exact enumeration for small controls
Every bound transverse mode belongs to SAM or a qualified separate/joint LAM DVR spectrum exactly once
Analytic-fit DVR acquisition protocol retained; intermediate spectra never trigger new electronic acquisitions
Rotation supplied as explicit integer/half-integer J blocks with M, spin and symmetry factors already included once
Absolute origin, SAM physical open threshold and each LAM zero-point energy recorded; positive spectral convolution only
Independent canonical back-integration within declared tolerance; occupation, spectrum, energy, J and grid errors have a combined budget below that tolerance
ME handoff retains resolved E,J and reference with no source or reference-rate rescaling
Versioned specification and implementation lock checked before execution; any scientific change requires a new version
coordinate_policy: Shared ESALC-I basis and native metric derivatives upstream. Bound SAM and DVR LAM identities partition the complete transverse inventory.
backend_policy: Backend-neutral owner artifact assembly. Electronic/IRC and finite DVR acquisition plans stay upstream; substantial validation runs only on approved compute hosts. Independent sector convolution is the declared separability approximation; coupled spectra may replace a joint LAM sector.
